R2 is significant but d=-0.099; R5b dies under a tuned baseline; R5c is smoke-only and the production checkpoint flips to baseline-wins (+10.37%); R1's win is init-attributed and its pooled effect fell from +0.1609 to +0.1178 at NFE=150. The namesake restart-blend still has no clean positive cell.
q1_assessment.decisive_missing_piece: One pre-registered positive cell for the restart-blend against a tuned baseline. GAP-43 closed the R3 fg_dev route (INCONCLUSIVE, tuned gate fails). GAP-53 closed R>1 (null, 2/4 seeds). The remaining mechanism route is GAP-54: hold the discrete class fixed (stochasticity=0 + coordinate-only restart) and test whether the continuous flow contracts; only a positive paired screen there justifies a larger block. No seed engineering.

Theorem 4 is conditional on a fixed (a,e), so contraction can only be tested by holding the class fixed.
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) Additive, default-off `sampler_stochasticity` passthrough (0.0 = deterministic CTMC) plus coordinate-only restart via the existing per-channel memory flags (charge=1, raw_pair=1); R=1 stays byte-stable. (2) Probe on K=8 existing priors at stochasticity=0: dim_changes == 0 and median per-round ratio < 1 with bootstrap CI upper < 1. (3) If it contracts, a paired R=2 screen (same stochasticity in both arms) must give mean d_fg < 0 and >= 3/4 seeds favourable before any larger block. (4) If the class still flips at stochasticity=0, record the lever closed and stop. No new seeds.
